claims.nodeLabel: The misappropriation allegation: Grusch's ICIG complaint and sworn testimony
claims.text: Grusch's written testimony to the House Oversight Committee contains no discussion of funding mechanisms, budget lines, or contractor financial arrangements; the financial specifics were reserved for classified session.

claims.nodeLabel: The misappropriation allegation: Grusch's ICIG complaint and sworn testimony
claims.text: Grusch's written testimony states he was 'informed in the course of my official duties of a multi-decade UAP crash retrieval and reverse engineering program' to which he was denied access, and refers to 'Non-Human Reverse Engineering Programs'.

edges.label: The access architecture that denied Grusch his read-ons is largely contractor-built and contractor-maintained
edges.note: Grusch was tasked to inventory the SAPs and CAPs relevant to the Task Force's congressional mandate and was refused. The billet lists, access rosters and classification guides that execute such refusals are administered in substantial part by security-support primes. No committee has requested those rosters.
